name: Balboa (Risaralda, Colombia)
description: White field with a grey-green triangle at the upper hoist and a red triangle at the lower fly.
history: Municipal flag of Balboa, a municipality in the department of Risaralda, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor.

features.role: triangle at the upper hoist corner
triangle at the lower fly corner
